Let w be a finite place with uniformiser ϖ, let K = `New.localIntGL` = GL_n(O_w), and let k_w be the
residue field. `New.basicDoubleCoset` n w j is the set of g with g and ϖ g⁻¹ integral and det g of
order j. T_j = `New.heckeGL` is the action of its indicator function with vol K = 1. On K-fixed
vectors, T_j is computed as a sum over subspaces of k_w^n, and T_i and T_j are related when
n = i + j.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.basicCosetRep`, `New.basicDoubleCoset_eq`: a representative for each subspace;
  `New.basicDoubleCoset` is one double coset.
* `New.heckeGL_eq_sum`: on K-fixed vectors, T_j is a sum over the subspaces of dimension j.
* `New.heckeGL_dual`: for n = i + j, T_j is ϖ times the operator of the inverse coset of T_i.
* `New.sub_one_mem_span_iff_atPlace`: for an integral point, a congruence modulo `a` is tested at
  the primes dividing `a`.
* `New.inf_supportedOn_le_principalLevel`: integral points supported on primes that, with their
  conjugates, do not divide `a` have principal level `a`.
* `New.block_embFin`: the block matrix `diag (γ, 1)`, relabelled along `ε`, commutes with the
  embedding into finite adeles.

* `New.levelSpace`: For a representation π of G, a subgroup K and a character χ of K, the submodule
  of vectors v with π(k)v = χ(k)v for all k in K.
* `New.heckeFun`: For a function f on G, the operator ∑ f(g)π(g), summed over chosen representatives

modules.note:
Let `w` be a split finite place (`star w ≠ w`) with residue field of order `q`. Through
`New.ofSplitPlace`, the spherical Hecke operators of `GL_n(E_w)` act on representations of the
finite adelic unitary group `New.Gf`. A vector is spherical at `w` when it lies in
`New.sphericalAt`, that is, when it is fixed by the integral elements `New.maxCompactAt` supported
at `w` and `w̄`.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.heckeSplit`: the operator `T_{w,j}` of the double coset `New.basicDoubleCoset` of
  `diag (ϖ 1_j, 1)`.
* `New.heckeSplit_star`: on vectors spherical at `w`, `T_{w̄,j}` is the action at `w` of the inverse
  double coset. Hence `New.heckeSplit_dual` (`ϖ T_{w̄,i} = T_{w,n-i}` on such vectors) and
  `New.heckeSplit_adjoint` (`T_{w̄,j}` is adjoint to `T_{w,j}` on spherical vectors, for a
  `G_f`-invariant pairing).
* `New.heckeSplit_comm`: the operators at two split places commute on vectors spherical at both.
* `New.IsUnitary.le_span_joint_eigenvectors`: in a representation unitary for a form `B`
  (`B y y > 0` for `y ≠ 0`, `B (π g x) (π g y) = B x y`), a finite-dimensional stable space of
  spherical vectors is spanned by joint eigenvectors. `New.IsUnitary.le_span_hecke_eigenvectors` is
  the form for places given by a predicate.
* `New.heckePolyEval`, `New.heckePolyOp`: the Hecke polynomial `∑ (-X)^i q^(i choose 2) T_{w,i}`,
  where `i` runs from `0` to `n`, `q` is the order of the residue field at `w`, and
  `New.heckePolyOp` takes the `T_{w,i}` to be the operators `New.heckeSplit`, while
  `New.heckePolyEval` allows any coefficients `t i`.
* `New.HasHeckePolynomial`: vectors spherical at `w` (`New.sphericalAt`) on which this polynomial
  acts by given scalars.

Notions from other files:
* `New.levelSpace`: For a representation π of G, a subgroup K and a character χ of K, the submodule
  of vectors v with π(k)v = χ(k)v for all k in K.
* `New.heckeFun`: For a function f on G, the operator ∑ f(g)π(g), summed over representatives g of
  G/K.
* `New.stdLevel`: The subgroup K₀ = G_f ∩ GL_n(Ô) of the finite adelic unitary group.
* `New.Gf.supportedOn`: The subgroup of G_f of elements supported on S ∪ S̄, that is, with component
  1 at every place outside S ∪ S̄; `New.Gf.trivialOn`: those with component 1 at every place in S.
* `New.localIntGL`: For a finite place w of E, the subgroup GL_n(O_w) of GL_n(E_w) of matrices that,
  with their inverses, have entries in the local integers.

modules.group: Hecke operators at unramified places and theta lifts
modules.note:
Let `w` be a split place of norm q, let S and T be hermitian spaces of ranks n and n + k, and let
the characters `a`, `b` be unramified at `w`. On the vacuum at `w` of the Weil representation
`New.pairWeil S T a b`, the Hecke operators of S and of T count subspaces of the kernels of an
integral matrix and of its transpose modulo `w`. By the q-binomial theorem the Hecke polynomial for
T at `w` is then the rescaled polynomial for S at w̄ times ∏_{l<k}(1 − q^l X), which is
`New.SiegelWeil.qPochhammer q k X`. This identity passes to theta lifts.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.AutChar.frobValue`: the complex number `χ(ϖ_w) q_w^(N/2)`, with
  `χ = New.AutChar.spaceChar a N` and `N = Fintype.card n`.
* `New.SiegelWeil.heckePolyOp_pairWeilTarget`: the identity on the vacuum.
  `New.SiegelWeil.hecke_transfer_of_equivariant` is its image under an equivariant linear map.
* `New.SiegelWeil.hecke_transfer_of_pairing`, `New.SiegelWeil.lift_swap_heckePolyOp`: the transfer
  through an equivariant bilinear map and through the transposed theta lift.
* `New.SiegelWeil.hasHeckePolynomial_of_pairing`, `New.SiegelWeil.hasHeckePolynomial_formLift`: the
  Hecke polynomial of a lift.
* `New.SiegelWeil.hasHeckePolynomial_qPochhammer`: the Hecke polynomial of a fixed vector.

Notions from other files:
* `New.WeilData`: Weil data on a stably unramified E. They consist of ȷ in E with ȷ = −ȷ̄, Im τȷ > 0
  for every τ in the CM type and (1 − ȷ⁻¹)/2 integral; a finite idele α for which the completed
  integers Ô are self-dual under (z, u) ↦ ψ_f(ȷαᾱzu); and a splitting character υ equal to −1 at
  uniformisers of the places w with w = w̄.
* `New.ofSplitPlace`: the map GL_n(E_w) → G_f, g ↦ the unitary element that is g at w and 1 off w,
  w̄.
* `New.LocField`: the completion E_w of E at the finite place w.
